shots.name: gate
shots.prompt: Golden-hour wide shot of the main gate of an upscale gated estate in Lekki, Lagos: a painted gatehouse with a red-and-white barrier arm on the right of the frame, a smiling guard in a neat uniform beside it, a clean dark SUV approaching the barrier, palms and duplex rooftops in warm sunlight across the upper part of the frame. The bottom 40% of the frame is calm, softly shaded interlocking paving with nothing important in it. No text, no signs, no logos, number plates out of frame.
